comment: Lunch peak I cannot take orders fast enough, customers see the queue and walk to another stall.
Taking orders and making change at the same time, always make mistakes during rush.
End of day I have no idea which dishes sold well. Everything in my head.
Peak hour is madness. If people could order from their phone my queue would be half.
I am not so good with numbers, hard to track daily takings and popular items.
Wrong orders happen when the waiter is rushing, then we lose the food cost.
When I sell out of a dish I have no way to tell people until they reach the front.
Reconciling cash at closing takes me 30 minutes every night.
Kiosk helps a bit but I still cannot see sales trends across the week.
During lunch we turn away customers because the line is too long. Lost sales every day.
Old customers ask what is finished, I keep repeating myself the whole day.
Getting the bill to the table and back slows down our table turnover.
I want to know my best sellers so I can prepare more, but no system.
Cash handling with wet hands while cooking, terrible.
We collect data on the kiosk but cannot make sense of it.
If phone ordering existed I could serve double the customers at lunch.
Sold out items cause a lot of arguments at the counter.
No proper record of what sells, I just guess my orders to the supplier.
Queue is my biggest enemy at peak. People give up and leave.
Payment and split bill among a big group takes forever.
Lunch queues at the food court eat up half my break. By the time I get food I have 10 minutes to eat.
When my group wants different stalls we each queue separately. So troublesome.
I never know how long the food will take. I just stand there and wait.
Splitting the bill with friends after dinner is always a mess.
Order ahead and just collect would be perfect for busy weekdays.
Hard to get the waiter's attention when it is crowded, then I wait even longer.
A buzz when my food is ready so I can go find seats first.
Standing in line is hard on my legs. Ordering from phone would help older folks.
One order for chicken rice and my friend laksa without two queues, please.
Waiting for the bill and splitting it takes 20 minutes at the end.
I want to know the wait time before I commit to a stall.
Food court very hot, need more fans.
Kiosk is ok but paying and splitting is still clumsy.
Peak lunch the queue snakes around, I often give up and eat elsewhere.
Notify me when ready, I hate hovering at the counter.
Ordering from my phone at the table would save a lot of waiting.
Too long to queue nowadays. Sometimes I skip lunch.
Wait time estimate would let me decide which stall.
Big group dinners, splitting the bill is a nightmare.
Pre-order before I leave the office and collect on arrival.
Queue plus finding a seat, very stressful during lunch hour.
Let me order from three stalls in one go and pay once.
Queue damn long during lunch, I always give up and go elsewhere.
Just tell me when it is ready so I can queue for another stall meanwhile.
Cashless order and pay, skip the whole line.
Hard to flag the waiter, then order comes wrong.
Real-time wait time is the one thing I want.
Splitting and paying should be doable from the phone.
Different cravings in the group means many queues. One cart please.
The chicken rice here is the best in Singapore.
Order ahead so lunch is ready when I reach.
The kiosk queue is also long during peak, defeats the purpose.
Order from multiple stalls, collect together, pay once.
Peak hour queue is unbearable, I plan my lunch around avoiding it.
Notify me, I will go chope seat first.
Wrong dishes arrive and then more waiting to fix.
Wait time and ready alert, that combo saves me daily.
Let me order and pay at the table without waving for staff.
Pre-order at 11.45, collect at 12, back to work by 12.15.
Prices keep going up everywhere these days.
Standing and waiting for food is dead time. Buzz me.
Paying should be as fast as ordering, right now it is not.
Just want to skip the lunch queue with my phone.
